- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hadestown is a modern retelling of the ancient Greek myth of Orpheus and Eurydice, set to a folk-opera score with a blend of blues, jazz, and Americana influences.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The story takes place in a post-apocalyptic world where Hadestown, the underworld, is ruled by Hades and Persephone.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The narrative revolves around two intertwining love stories: Orpheus and Eurydice, and Hades and Persephone.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Orpheus, a young musician, falls in love with Eurydice, who makes a deal with Hades to work in Hadestown.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The musical explores themes of love, power, freedom, and redemption, with a score by Anaïs Mitchell.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The show features a talented ensemble cast and innovative staging and design.
